deploy-bot: Deploy started: staged rollout v2.4.1 -> 10% eu-west-1 now. /deploy status #deploy-1758802468 :rocket:

 tj: saw small tail latency blip on 99th at 09:12, +120ms vs baseline. nothing huge but worth flagging.

 rachel: thanks tj. is this in the canary only or seen in the 10% sample?

 tj: only in canary shards so far. sample size small, but spikes correlate with large prompt lengths.

 mike: any errors or increased 5xxs?

 tj: 5xxs flat. grpc timeouts up slightly (~0.3%) on the same nodes.

 sre-oncall: can we get K/V cache stats and GPU load? if cache churn↑ + long seqs that could explain.

 deploy-bot: Attachments: logs uploaded to s3://redwood-logs/deploys/1758802468/logs.tar.gz. To rollback: `/deploy rollback --id 1758802468 --to v2.4.0 --region eu-west-1`

 olivia: also seeing a tiny uptick in embed cosine outliers on our monitoring eval set (2 failed prompts). unclear if noise.

 rachel: ok, proposal: HOLD ramp at 10%, pin traffic, enable extra KV cache warming on canary pool, run a focused 15-min probe with long prompts. if no improvement, roll back. thoughts? :thinking_face:

 mike: +1. can we flip autoscale to prefer warm pools and increase kv-cache TTL temporarily?

 sre-oncall: I can bump kv TTL and enable extra prefetch, will monitor GPU mem & GC. giving 10-min window to observe after change.

 tj: will run a targeted load of 500 long-seq requests against canary to reproduce. linking script: `./scripts/long-seq-probe --target canary-eu --count 500`

 deploy-bot: Ramp halted at 10% per request from @rachel. Change window note added. Release notes updated: "halted ramp due to latency spike; investigating KV cache and long-sequence behavior."

 olivia: setting a small eval on the embed probe set now — will post results in 10m.

 mike: if probe reproduces, prefer rollback to v2.4.0 for safety. if it's transient and cache fix works, we can continue.

 rachel: agree. decision flow: if 99p latency > +100ms for 5m OR embed failures > 0.5% then rollback. otherwise continue after warmup + probe.

 sre-oncall: KV TTL bumped, prefetch enabled on canary pool. watching metrics (GPU load, GC, queue depth).

 tj: probe running, ~120/500 so far. initial matches to spike. sending raw trace for two worst ones: link https://logs.internal/trace/1758802468/traceA

 olivia: embed pilot 10m: 2/200 mismatches, similar to initial. may be related to tokenization edge-case with long contexts.

 rachel: ok this is enough. let's enact rollback plan if probe finishes with >3% of requests >100ms or any embed mismatch in the next 10m. mike, can you prepare the rollback runbook?

 mike: on it. rollback runbook: verify target nodes, run `/deploy rollback --id 1758802468 --to v2.4.0 --region eu-west-1 --no-bake`, wait for health checks, then cut traffic. ETA ~7m once triggered.

 deploy-bot: Scheduled NOTE: rollback command will require :deploy-approver: approval. run `/deploy approve rollback 1758802468` to proceed.

 rachel: approving contingency. we prefer to hold and collect until threshold reached. updating page in runbook and change window.

 tj: probe finished: 42/500 requests exceeded 100ms threshold (8.4%). traces show cache miss patterns + GC spikes.

 olivia: embed eval final: 8/400 mismatches (2%), aligned with tj's probe.

 rachel: decision: ROLLBACK to v2.4.0 for eu-west-1. mike please execute.

 mike: executing rollback now. `/deploy rollback --id 1758802468 --to v2.4.0 --region eu-west-1`

 deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by mike. Step 1: draining canary nodes... Step 2: deploying v2.4.0 to replaced nodes... health checks in progress.

 sre-oncall: monitoring: 99p latency dropping back to baseline within 2 minutes. GPU mem stable.

 deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Traffic reverted to v2.4.0 in eu-west-1. Incident postmortem checklist created: https://confluence/internal/pm/1758802468-postmortem.

 rachel: thanks everyone. action items: 1) RL on tokenization for long contexts (olivia + research), 2) kv-cache tuning defaults (sre-oncall + infra), 3) add synthetic long-seq probes to preflight (tj + eng-runtime). Will schedule follow-up sync. :white_check_mark:

 mike: noted, will also add rollback quick-approve template for emergencies.

 deploy-bot: Closing thread per owner rachel. If anything new pops up, reopen or create follow-up. :lock:
